claim: Original isolation and characterisation of exendin-4 from Gila monster (Heloderma suspectum) venom.
DURATION-1: exenatide once weekly vs twice daily in type 2 diabetes; HbA1c −1.9% vs −1.5% at 30 weeks.
EXSCEL: exenatide once weekly was noninferior (but not superior) to placebo for cardiovascular outcomes in type 2 diabetes.
